title: agentic-workflow agent registry
description: The machine-readable agent registry printed by tools/agents.mjs --json. A public interface (same status as the ledger and pending-gates formats): a wrapper reads this instead of parsing agent-file frontmatter and banner wording. Versioning rule: the shape is strict, so any added, removed or retyped field ships as a minor plugin version bump with a CHANGELOG line naming the change.

plugin_version.description: The version from the plugin manifest at generation time.

source.description: 'plugin' for a shipped agent, 'project' for a .claude/agents file that shadows no plugin agent.

description.description: The plugin default description (never the TUNED-prefixed shadow one).

summary.description: The description up to the first '. ' or ' — '.

phase.description: The lifecycle phase this role serves (a frontmatter phase: wins, else the fixed map, else on-demand).

model.description: The plugin default model ('inherit' when the plugin file names none).

tools.description: The plugin default tools list (a project-only agent: its own tools: line, or null when it has none).

effective.description: The settings a project override resolves to; equals the defaults when there is no override.

model.description: The resolved model; the literal 'inherit' is kept (no session to resolve it).

runtime.description: 'claude' by default, else the override's runtime value.

effort.description: The resolved effort, or null when unset.

boundary_escalation.description: 'on' for reviewer by default, null for every other agent.

tools.description: The tools list the agent actually runs with (the override's tools: when set, else the plugin default). null = the file has no tools: line (unset: all tools on claude, read-only sandbox on codex). On codex it also sets the sandbox: Write/Edit → workspace-write.

override.description: null when no .claude/agents shadow exists, else the shadow and what it changes.

kind.description: What the shadow changes vs the current base, derived by comparison: any of model, runtime, effort, boundary_escalation, tools, skills, prompt.

base_version.description: The plugin version stamped in the shadow's banner, or null.

base_sha.description: The first 12 hex of the base sha256 stamped in the banner, or null (pre-1.54 shadows).
